lore: 中央庭把信号识别资料、可复核的工程方法与联防队伍的现场经验写入同一份预案。研究者说明反制能够干预的部分，物资部门准备器材，常规舰队在接触中把有限的机会转化为实际战果。
application: 建设全国一处危机联合防务中心。在有效联防和公共档案支持下，投入800能源／500合金／100稀有水晶准备一份反制物资。作战舰队抵达投影所在星系后，由中心下达部署，使当时敌方投影作战舰的武器伤害修正−20%、射速修正−10%，持续90日；全帝国冷却180日。战斗仍由正常舰队完成。

building.name: 危机联合防务中心
requires: active local D14 garrison/orbital joint defense

preparation.payment: native decision once; effect no second debit
preparation.limit: one stock across all owned colonies, including paused stock
preparation.discard: original owner may discard own stock even if center/tech/control fail; other stock unchanged

deployment.cost: one local prepared stock; no new resource fee
deployment.source: own controlled uncloaked enabled fleet with enabled military ship and at least one eligible hostile projection in system
deployment.selection: random one eligible own fleet; affects eligible projections in its current system only
deployment.effect: acc_projection_disrupted on eligible military ships: ship_weapon_damage -0.20, ship_fire_rate_mult -0.10
deployment.atomic: full center/stock/cooldown/field guard before consumption; subsequent field selection independent of consumed stock
deployment.bombardment: already prepared stock can fire while center bombarded if control and joint defense still valid
deployment.timer: no refresh/stack of existing hit; no late arrivals; leaving system keeps remaining time

target_contract.scope: source fleet -> same solar system -> target fleet -> military ships
target_contract.hostility: target controller is_hostile source controller; explicit PREV stack, independent of UI ROOT
exclude: ordinary countries even with copied fleet flag

lifecycle.unavailable: center/control/D14/archive/research loss blocks use but retains stock and nation slot; restoration resumes
lifecycle.transfer_or_destroy: existing ACS clear removes unspent local stock; original knowledge/country cooldown and fired ship timers unchanged

interfaces.existing_battle_and_analysis: projection must still be defeated by actual combat; original anchor investigation/analysis remains

performance.scan: prepare checks own colonies; deployment checks own fleets, then chosen current system fleets/ships; on demand only

sources.constraint: 中央庭公共协调、科学验证与普通工业共同支撑防务；中心、费用和干扰效果为Mod设计，不量产个人神器，不宣称已解释黑门本质。

native_reference.scope: planet stock / country cooldown / per-ship timed effect

limitations: 仅验证结构和项目内显式引用，不验证原版触发器、效果、作用域、数值平衡或事件可达性。
未校验引擎隐式岗位、修正、trait、outliner 图标；须以最新冷启动日志和游戏内显示验收。
未运行游戏；静态 pass 不能变更 runtime_status，也不能代替存档及日志证据。

validation.fixture_note: F02/A12完成知识与D14联防是已验证接口输入；正式准备/部署/放弃决议及效果执行严格作用域栈，未知语法报错。
limitations: 原生研究抽取、建筑建造/帝国限额、实际扣费、真实战斗/计时/显示和存读档未验。
28项为源码检查；资源、控制和倒计时夹具不是原生运行或序列化证据。

runtime.priority: 阶段试玩仍优先D12；F03仅取中心备料和真实投影现场效果的必要代表，共用关键读档，不逐包重测。
